findings.summary: Whole-file digest can void an honest run if a concurrent operator session writes installed_plugins.json mid-run (fails closed: costs a re-run, never hides a leak); #416 allows comparing only vfkb-ds- rows instead
Record stores only a boolean; before/after digests and new vfkb-ds- paths would make a voided run diagnosable
No unmetered unit-level guard; the fake-claude-on-PATH harness from this review could become a deterministic behaviour test
Same leak shape may exist in other scenarios; author narrowed it to cross-repo-record.mjs:131 (others set vfkb@vfkb false), filed as #437, leak UNVERIFIED
Empty HOME with unset CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR resolves the guard path to relative .claude (negligible)

ruledOut: post-compare async write (execFileSync blocks; empty sandbox config loads no plugin hooks)
sandbox home leftover (inside root, rmSync'd; no vfkb-ds-* left in TMPDIR)
agent breakage from HOME change (node/git from unchanged PATH, absolute CLI path)
secrets in record, AI attribution in commit
